<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="raw-sources">
<h1>Raw Sources</h1>
<p>Raw sources are the original input files stored under <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Raw/Sources/</span></code>. Every
source tracked by WikiMason carries metadata for identity, content integrity,
and provenance.</p>
<section id="source-identity">
<h2>Source identity</h2>
<p>Each source gets a stable <strong>source ID</strong> on first import:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>src_&lt;YYYYMMDD&gt;_&lt;sha256-prefix-12&gt;
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Example: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">src_20260529_7a91f04c2bb1</span></code></p>
<p>The source ID never changes, even if the file is renamed or its content is
updated. It is the primary key in the manifest and the stable reference used
in wiki page citations.</p>
</section>
<section id="metadata-storage">
<h2>Metadata storage</h2>
<section id="text-sources-md">
<h3>Text sources (.md)</h3>
<p>Text sources embed wikimason metadata as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wm_</span></code>-prefixed keys in the YAML
frontmatter:</p>
<div class="highlight-yaml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nn">---</span>
<span class="nt">wm_source_id</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">src_20260529_8f3a1f1b</span>
<span class="nt">wm_original_filename</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;meeting-notes.md&quot;</span>
<span class="nt">wm_current_filename</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;meeting-notes.md&quot;</span>
<span class="nt">wm_source_kind</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">text</span>
<span class="nt">wm_content_sha256</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;...&quot;</span>
<span class="nt">title</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;My</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Source&quot;</span>
<span class="nn">---</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wm_</span></code> prefix namespace avoids collision with user metadata. These fields
are managed by WikiMason and should not be edited manually.</p>
</section>
<section id="binary-sources-pdf-images-etc">
<h3>Binary sources (PDF, images, etc.)</h3>
<p>Binary sources get a sidecar file:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>Raw/Sources/report.pdf
Raw/Sources/report.pdf.wikimason.json
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>The sidecar is a JSON file containing the same <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wm_</span></code> fields as text sources.
For binary files, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">hash_scope</span></code> is <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">full_file_bytes</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="content-hashing">
<h2>Content hashing</h2>
<p>For text sources, the content hash is computed from the <strong>body only</strong> (after
removing the YAML frontmatter), normalized to LF line endings. This allows
metadata-only edits to not trigger content-change detection.</p>
</section>
<section id="manifest">
<h2>Manifest</h2>
<p>The source manifest is stored at <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Schema/source-manifest.jsonl</span></code>. It is keyed
by <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_id</span></code> (not path). One JSON line per source:</p>
<div class="highlight-json notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nt">&quot;source_id&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;src_20260529_8f3a1f1b&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nt">&quot;path&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Raw/Sources/meeting-notes.md&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="commands">
<h2>Commands</h2>
<section id="add-a-source-file">
<h3>Add a source file</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>add<span class="w"> </span>&lt;path&gt;<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="list-sources">
<h3>List sources</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>list<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="show-source-details">
<h3>Show source details</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>show<span class="w"> </span>&lt;source-id-or-path&gt;<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="verify-source-integrity">
<h3>Verify source integrity</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>verify<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="recompute-hashes-from-current-file-state">
<h3>Recompute hashes from current file state</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>rehash<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="check-source-manifest-integrity">
<h3>Check source manifest integrity</h3>
<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span><span class="nb">source</span><span class="w"> </span>lint<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="rename-detection">
<h2>Rename detection</h2>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">source</span> <span class="pre">verify</span></code> detects renames by comparing <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">source_id</span></code> and
content hash. If a file moves to a new path but keeps the same source ID and
hash, it is reported as a rename rather than a new source.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
